2005151.title: Seat assembly component inventory
guidance: Gather and visually inspect 1 EA of ML Mountain Seat/Saddle (Product Number SE-M798), 1 EA of Seat Post (Product Number SP-2981), 1 EA of Seat Lug (Product Number SL-0931), and 4 EA of Pinch Bolt (Product Number PB-6109). See the component inventory in illustration 2005151.

Support Seat Post (Product Number SP-2981) in an assumed padded assembly jig and provisionally fit Seat Lug (Product Number SL-0931) and ML Mountain Seat/Saddle (Product Number SE-M798) using the applicable component guidance. Do not force a questionable fit.

Fit the 4 EA of Pinch Bolt (Product Number PB-6109) at the positions confirmed by the applicable component guidance, using a suitable hand tool. Refer to that guidance for fastening requirements; no settings are specified in this demo.
